attempts.text: [{"name": "user_brand_affinity_v2", "idea": "Share of the user's orders in the 120-day window that contain the product's brand, and days since the user last bought that brand; the product brand is taken from all lines, so the value does not depend on the batch.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), pb AS (SELECT product_id, max(brand_name) AS brand FROM lines WHERE brand_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), un AS (SELECT o.user_id, count(*) AS n_u FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY o.user_id), ub AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.brand_name, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS n_b, max(l.ts) AS last_ts FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id WHERE l.brand_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.user_id, l.brand_name) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, CASE WHEN pb.brand IS NULL OR un.n_u IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(ub.n_b, 0) * 1.0 / un.n_u END AS ag_ub_share, epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - ub.last_ts) / 86400.0 AS ag_ub_days_since FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pb ON pb.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN un ON un.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN ub ON ub.user_id = c.user_id AND ub.brand_name = pb.brand;"}, {"name": "up_decayed_frequency", "idea": "Recency-weighted purchase frequency of the product by the user (sum over distinct orders of exp(-age/14 days)), raw and normalised by the user's own decayed order count.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), uw AS (SELECT o.user_id, sum(exp(-epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - o.ts) / 86400.0 / 14.0)) AS w_u FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY o.user_id), op AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.product_id, l.ts FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id), pw AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, sum(exp(-epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - ts) / 86400.0 / 14.0)) AS w_p FROM op GROUP BY user_id, product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, COALESCE(pw.w_p, 0.0) AS ag_up_decay14, CASE WHEN uw.w_u > 0 THEN COALESCE(pw.w_p, 0.0) / uw.w_u ELSE NULL END AS ag_up_decay_share FROM cand c LEFT JOIN uw ON uw.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN pw ON pw.user_id = c.user_id AND pw.product_id = c.product_id;"}, {"name": "category_choice_v2", "idea": "Within the product's category (taken from all lines, so batch-independent), the share of the user's category orders that picked this product, and whether the user's latest category order picked it (substitution vs loyalty).", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), pc AS (SELECT product_id, max(master_category_id) AS cat FROM lines WHERE master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), ul AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.ts, l.product_id, l.master_category_id AS cat FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id WHERE l.master_category_id IS NOT NULL), co AS (SELECT user_id, cat, order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, cat ORDER BY ts DESC, order_id DESC) AS rk FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, cat, order_id, ts FROM ul) x), ucn AS (SELECT user_id, cat, count(*) AS n_cat FROM co GROUP BY user_id, cat), upc AS (SELECT ul.user_id, ul.product_id, ul.cat, count(DISTINCT ul.order_id) AS n_p, max(CASE WHEN co.rk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_last FROM ul JOIN co ON ul.user_id = co.user_id AND ul.cat = co.cat AND ul.order_id = co.order_id GROUP BY ul.user_id, ul.product_id, ul.cat) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, CASE WHEN ucn.n_cat IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE least(1.0, COALESCE(upc.n_p, 0) * 1.0 / ucn.n_cat) END AS ag_up_cat_choice, CASE WHEN ucn.n_cat IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(upc.in_last, 0) END AS ag_uc_last_pick FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN ucn ON ucn.user_id = c.user_id AND ucn.cat = pc.cat LEFT JOIN upc ON upc.user_id = c.user_id AND upc.product_id = c.product_id AND upc.cat = pc.cat;"}, {"name": "up_order_count_due", "idea": "Number of the user's orders since the product was last bought, and that count divided by the user's typical number of orders per purchase of the product (order-based dueness instead of day-based).", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), uo AS (SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.ts DESC, o.order_id DESC) AS rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id) AS n_u FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id), op AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.product_id FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id), upo AS (SELECT op.user_id, op.product_id, min(uo.rn) - 1 AS since, count(*) AS n_p, max(uo.n_u) AS n_u FROM op JOIN uo ON op.order_id = uo.order_id GROUP BY op.user_id, op.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, upo.since AS ag_up_orders_since, upo.since * upo.n_p * 1.0 / upo.n_u AS ag_up_ord_due FROM cand c JOIN upo ON upo.user_id = c.user_id AND upo.product_id = c.product_id;"}, {"name": "p_buyer_repeat_penetration", "idea": "Item-level share of later orders (after the first) of multi-order buyers in the last 90 days that contain the product again, smoothed: how much of a buyer's ongoing basket the product occupies.", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH b AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_p FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY user_id, product_id), u AS (SELECT user_id, count(*) AS n_u FROM orders WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY user_id HAVING count(*) >= 2) SELECT b.product_id, (sum(b.n_p) - count(*) + 1.0) / (sum(u.n_u) - count(*) + 5.0) AS ag_p_buyer_penetration FROM b JOIN u ON b.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY b.product_id;"}]
